canonical_documentation_proposal.why_new: The current guide says to use producer scoped evidence and distinguish typed gates, but the retained graph's #131 issue-level prerequisite labels are generic and have no criterion IDs/slice mapping. A durable instruction to bind each graph gate to consumed producer criteria would prevent both false whole-issue blockers and unsafe premature integration.
canonical_documentation_proposal.exact_proposed_text: For a typed issue-to-issue prerequisite, record the exact producer acceptance criterion or artifact consumed by the successor slice. An open producer issue does not by itself block every successor slice: decide readiness from current evidence for the named criterion on the candidate tree. If a graph edge has only a generic issue-level scope and no criterion mapping, leave that successor slice unclassified until the edge is refined; do not translate the producer's whole-issue OPEN state into a blanket blocker. A producer's partial foundation satisfies only the criteria its receipt actually proves.
canonical_documentation_proposal.removed_stale_guidance: The prior receipt's shorthand that #131 is blocked by #125/#129/#130 as whole issues is superseded. No repository documentation or original graph/contracts were edited.
